headline: Congress named a post office building in Rosebud, South Dakota, the Ben Reifel Post Office Building.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 123 East Sharpfish Street in Rosebud, South Dakota. The new name is the Ben Reifel Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 21, 2020.
